name: flip
description: Turn one-off agent research into source-grounded notebooks another agent can continue, challenge, and publish from.

interface.longDescription: Capture the material research relies on, keep evidence and claims at honest states, pursue follow-on questions, and carry an attributed record across agent handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Assess whether Flip fits this repository and propose the smallest useful pilot without changing files.
Create a Flip notebook for this research question.
Capture and grade the sources supporting this claim.
Audit this notebook's claims and prepare a handoff.
